endorsements.name: Viettel Post
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-51026
endorsements.description: Bytebase 0.12.0 before 1.0.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user. The flaw stems from trusting client-supplied GitLab provider configuration in the POST /api/auth/login/GITLAB_SELF_HOST endpoint. Attackers can set instanceUrl to a server they control that returns an active user with a chosen email. Bytebase then issues session tokens for that principal, letting attackers impersonate existing users including the Owner or create new members.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)

endorsements.name: Viettel Post
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-58386
endorsements.description: ZoneMinder versions 1.37.0 before 1.38.0 contain a path traversal vulnerability in the files view that allows authenticated users to read arbitrary files. The path parameter is not properly validated before being passed to output_file, enabling attackers with Events view permission to access sensitive files like configuration files containing database credentials.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 4.0, 7.1)

endorsements.name: Viettel Post
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-71419
endorsements.description: UVdesk core-framework before 1.1.7 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the SwiftMailer configuration identifier parameter of the createMailerConfiguration action. Attackers with ROLE_AGENT can inject malicious script into the identifier field, which is persisted and executed when other members access the configuration update page.

endorsements.name: Viettel Post
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-71420
endorsements.description: UVdesk core-framework before 1.1.7 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the saved reply endpoint that allows authenticated agents to access replies restricted to other support groups. Attackers with ROLE_AGENT can enumerate saved reply identifiers and read content reserved for groups and teams they do not belong to.

endorsements.name: Viettel Post
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-71421
endorsements.description: UVdesk core-framework before 1.1.7 contains an improper privilege management vulnerability in the editAgent endpoint that allows agents with agent-management privilege to escalate their own role to administrator. Attackers can submit their own account identifier with a role parameter set to ROLE_ADMIN to gain full administrative control over agents, tickets, and mail configuration.

endorsements.name: Viettel Post
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-71433
endorsements.description: Kaneo before 2.1.6 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to access other workspaces by supplying project, task, label or workspace identifiers to API routes lacking membership checks. Attackers who obtain identifiers, for example from shared project links, can read projects and tasks, modify or delete tasks, labels and comments, and search workspace contents.
